regime.genre: progressively edited benchmark, endpoint slice only (v0/v8)

human_population.determined_how: Dataset documentation (OpAI-Bench card, Bsharat et al. 2026): human documents from news, essays, reports and abstracts; no per-author demographics recorded

drops_manifest.reason: preliminary sample only (n=1996 normalised rows from 196029 split rows)
measured on the local interpreter only; CI covers the matrix
no threshold was fitted on this sample; AUROC/TPR@FPR are threshold-free

the OpAI-Bench train split repeats each pure-human v0 document once per generator; these rows are byte-identical to U1 rows (same document_hash_id, different record_id and generator) and are excluded so the sample is disjoint from U1 by content hash. Exclusion is by identity, never by detector score.
this seed record reports one pooled slice per dataset; finer slices are wave-2 work
rows with 0 < ai_sentence_ratio < 1 carry no binary label; they are the U4 spine, not U1 evidence

run.reporting_rules: Labelled rows only; abstentions counted separately from AUROC/TPR (abstained rows still contribute their score); no score threshold fitted — AUROC and TPR@FPR are threshold-free; native FPR/TPR at the detector's native categorical verdict; bootstrap 95% CIs, 1000 resamples, seed 20261110

fpr_native.operating_point: builtin-heuristic native verdict (analyze_text); no score threshold

known_failure_modes: fully machine text (v8) scores lower than pure human text (v0) on this slice: AUROC 0.4234 on this sample — the endpoint comparison inverts the baseline
only the v0/v8 endpoint rows carry binary labels; the partial rows are excluded from this record
limitations: not validated for texts below 80 words (the detector's minimum)
not validated for generators newer than the record's declared vintage
not validated for human populations outside the record's declared population
no reviewer has assessed this record; it is a preliminary seed, not a reviewed validation
the sample is a strided subset of the split, not a full-corpus evaluation
near-duplicate rate was not measured for this sample

contamination_flag is 'no' because the builtin detector is a hand-written stylometric heuristic with no training: it was not trained on this dataset or on any other text corpus, so it cannot have memorised evaluation rows
the 1555 partial (mixed-origin) rows in this sample are the U4 spine, not U1 evidence, and are excluded from this record
per-version and per-operation detector curves are not reported in this record (wave-2 concern)
this sample supersedes the U1 500-row sample (evr-20261106-opai-bench-builtin-heuristic); the U1 cache is preserved and the two samples are disjoint by content hash
